# mailboxorg_mail (Data Source)

Looks up a mail address (mailbox, forward or catch-all) at mailbox.org (`mail.get`). Password and postal address data are never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailboxorg_mail" "example" {
  mail = "user@example.com"
}

output "mailbox_plan" {
  value = data.mailboxorg_mail.example.plan
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mail` (String) The mail address to look up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the address is active.
- `additional_cloud_quota` (String) Additional cloud quota.
- `additional_mail_quota` (String) Additional mail quota.
- `aliases` (List of String) Alias addresses.
- `allow_nets` (String) Networks allowed to log in.
- `alternate_mail` (String) Alternate (recovery) mail address.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Enabled capabilities, such as `MAIL_SPAMPROTECTION`.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `deletion_date` (String) Planned deletion date, if any.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `forwards` (List of String) Forwarding targets.
- `id` (String) The mail address.
- `inboxsave` (Boolean) Whether forwarded mail is also kept in the inbox.
- `language` (String) Language (RFC 5646).
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `mailarchive_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the mail archive is enabled.
- `memo` (String) Free-text memo.
- `plan` (String) Current plan: `light`, `standard` or `premium`.
- `plans_available` (List of String) Plans this address can be switched to.
- `require_reset_password` (Boolean) Whether the user must reset the password at next login.
- `type` (String) Address type: `forward`, `inbox` or `inboxforward`.
- `uid` (String) Internal user ID.
- `uid_extern` (String) External user ID.
